heading: Mutual Fund Activity and Stock Performance

html_bullets.point: Mutual funds showed significant buying activity in Paytm during April, indicating positive investor sentiment towards the stock.
Paytm's stock rose nearly 10% in intraday trade on expectations of achieving profitability sooner, following a 54% reduction in its net loss for FY25.
One97 Communications, the parent company of Paytm, was not included in the MSCI indices, contrary to market expectations.
Nuvama Research suggests that Paytm could be included in the MSCI Global Standard Index during the upcoming rebalancing, with an expected inflow of 249 million following its addition.

Antfin Netherlands Holding BV offloaded 1.28 crore shares of One97 Communications, reducing its stake by 4%, while Goldman Sachs Singapore Pte.-ODI purchased 37,35,000 shares at an average price of Rs 823.1.
Ant Financial plans a Rs 2,200 crore stake sale via block deals, impacting investor sentiment.
One97 Communications reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 539.80 crore for the March 2025 quarter, a slight improvement from Rs 549.60 crore in the previous quarter.
For Q4 FY25, Paytm reported a revenue of ₹1,911 Cr, with EBITDA Before ESOP improving to ₹81 Cr. The company achieved close to breakeven PAT at ₹(23) Cr, reflecting positive growth momentum.
Paytm reported a 1% increase in revenue for Q4 but faced an exceptional loss of ₹522 crore.
Vijay Shekhar Sharma forecasts Paytm to turn PAT positive in Q1FY26, despite reporting a net loss of ₹539.8 crore in Q4 FY25 due to a one-time exceptional charge.
Paytm has approved an investment of Rs 8.7 crore to acquire a 25% stake in Brazilian finance firm Dinie, as part of its strategy to expand merchant payments and financial services internationally.
Paytm is expanding its global footprint with new subsidiaries in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Singapore, aiming to drive revenue growth from UPI services.
Paytm is set to launch AI-driven financial features aimed at enhancing user experience and potentially becoming significant profit drivers within 1-2 years, as stated by CEO Vijay Shekhar Sharma.
Paytm is slowing down on hiring and may not replace exiting staff, focusing on cost optimization through increased automation and artificial intelligence.
JM Financial has maintained a buy call on One97 Communications with a revised target price of Rs 1,070, expecting the company to sustain profitability and benefit from network effects.
Emkay Global Financial has recommended a buy rating on One97 Communications with a target price of Rs 1050, citing expectations of turning net profit-positive in FY26.
One97 Communications has disclosed its schedule for Analysts’ and Investors’ Meetings, including events in Mumbai and Singapore from May 23 to June 4, 2025.
One97 Communications and Vijay Shekhar Sharma paid Rs 2.22 crore to settle allegations of violating public-issue regulations, including the cancellation of 2.1 crore ESOPs granted to Sharma.
One97 Communications allotted 63,108 equity shares under the Employee Stock Option Scheme (ESOS), increasing its paid-up equity share capital to Rs 63,79,08,591.
